item.text:
Fixed the HTTP boundary: challenges now include UTF-8 byte Content-Length; 204 responses omit body and framing headers.

Added ASCII/multibyte challenge and 204 regression tests. All **20 tests pass**; README reporting is updated.

Ignore rules permit curated run records and SESSION_ID while excluding backups, auth, and secrets. No secret/backup contents read, servers started, or cloud/live actions taken.
